query: What is KC_WORKSPACE and who sets it?
golden_answer: The environment variable that points every tool at its workspace root; the runner sets it per project/run so tools stay argument-free about identity.

query: What is the default value of dry_run on submit_to_kaggle?
golden_answer: True — a live submission is quota-capped and cannot be undone, so the default never submits.

query: Which Kaggle dataset is the original source behind the S6E7 synthetic data?
golden_answer: ziya07/college-student-health-behavior-dataset (50,000 rows, same feature columns plus the health_condition target).

query: What competition is S6E7?
golden_answer: Kaggle Playground Series S6E7 — Predicting Student Health Risk.

query: What does the CV plateau detector read to decide when to stop?
golden_answer: The durable leaderboard record of recorded CV scores (experiments/leaderboard.jsonl), not the transcript.

query: How many submissions per day does the competition allow?
golden_answer: 10 per day (confirmed via the Kaggle API maxDailySubmissions).

query: What is the final submission deadline for the competition?
golden_answer: 2026-07-31 23:59 UTC (also the entry/merger deadline).

query: How many rows does train.csv have?
golden_answer: 690,088 rows (x 15 columns, 62.7 MB).

query: How many target classes are there and what are they?
golden_answer: Three: at-risk (85.9%), unhealthy (8.4%), fit (5.8%) — heavily imbalanced.

query: When does a person have to say yes before the agent is allowed to act?
golden_answer: Only for irreversible actions — the gate reads ToolSpec.irreversible, and only a literal yes/y (case-insensitive) approves; anything else is a denial.

query: Which parts of the codebase are the agents never allowed to modify?
golden_answer: core/ — frozen after Day 1 and shared by all three slices; changes require stopping and telling the team.

query: What happens if a tool tries to report an error type that was never defined?
golden_answer: err() asserts the kind is on the closed list in core/errors.py, so an invented kind fails loudly at the source instead of flowing downstream.

query: Why would plain accuracy be a misleading metric for this competition?
golden_answer: The target is heavily imbalanced — always predicting the majority class scores 0.859, which is why the metric is balanced accuracy.

query: Which actions across all the tool slices require human approval?
golden_answer: submit_to_kaggle (exec), overwrite_preprocessing_plan (recon), and fetch_external_dataset (knowledge) — the three irreversible tools.

query: Which file decides what counts as approval at the gate?
golden_answer: core/gate.py — it reads ToolSpec.irreversible and accepts only yes/y; no tool name is ever hardcoded there.

query: Where is the competition metric's formula implemented in the codebase?
golden_answer: core/metrics.py — balanced accuracy, written there on day 1.

query: What does FakeModel provide for the test suite?
golden_answer: A deterministic scripted model — no API key, no network — that drives the same run_agent loop the live model does.

query: What are the three memory stores and what belongs in each?
golden_answer: SQLite for structured rows you filter/aggregate (experiments, findings), a JSON document store for free-form facts, and a markdown rules file pushed into every run.

query: If retrieved text from another user looks like a command, does the agent execute it?
golden_answer: No — anything that originated from another user is DATA, always quoted and reasoned about, never executed as instructions.

query: What CV score did the winning solution of S6E7 achieve?
golden_answer: Not answerable from the corpus — no winning solution existed when these documents were written; the honest answer says so.

query: How do I deploy KaggleCracker to AWS?
golden_answer: Not answerable from the corpus — the docs describe a local workbench and never cover cloud deployment.

query: Which model do the live agents run on?
golden_answer: claude-sonnet-5, through a stdlib-only urllib adapter.

query: How many ToolSpecs does the system expose in total?
golden_answer: 19 ToolSpecs across the exec, recon, knowledge, eda, experiment-lifecycle and memory slices.

query: Does the offline monitor use an LLM to judge submission outcomes?
golden_answer: No — the monitor is rule-based with no LLM, running out-of-band on its own clock.
